tasks.DefineProblem: Understand the problem of finding minimum squares that sum up to a given number and include edge cases such as zero and negative numbers.
tasks.FindAlgorithm: Research and select an algorithm to solve the problem.
tasks.HandleEdgeCases: Define how the function should behave for specific edge cases such as zero, negative numbers, and perfect squares.
tasks.ImplementFunction: Write Python function based on selected algorithm, considering all edge cases.
tasks.TestFunction: Verify the correctness of the implemented function with provided test cases and additional edge cases.
